7919.title: Hidden fork placement remains undiscoverable
7919.rootCauseOneLine: Pin and section mutations persist placement but leave fork visibility hidden, so normal and pinned-root queries exclude it.
7919.proposedFix: Choose explicit promotion or hidden-state action suppression before changing the shared action contract and behavior.
7919.caveats: Repeated API reproduction in two clean trusted checkouts. Pin timestamp is saved on main. Chrome unavailable; macOS full-pane UI and header unverified. Reproduction test is inline under the reports repository publication policy. No PR: product decision and public action-contract changes exceed simple-fix scope.
